reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Thunder (revenge).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 54 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.
